discovery_method: middle-form version probe + source-level fix-gap verification (same gap window as CVE-2026-82209; see docs/analysis/CURL_MIDDLEFORM_VERIFY_20260921.md)

public_upstream.fixed_feature: connection-config comparison includes (c1->native_ca_store == c2->native_ca_store), upstream master lib/vtls/vtls_config.c:144

oh_source.gap_evidence: native_ca_store appears only in setopt.c:2470/2485 (option assignment) and urldata.h:340 (field definition) plus legitimate backend reads (gtls.c/openssl.c/wolfssl.c/doh.c); the connection-reuse comparison match_ssl_primary_config() at lib/vtls/vtls.c:176 lists every other ssl_primary_config field but omits native_ca_store
oh_source.introduced_by: 148534db57dda611cf8516e92e4d6e35fc1e5074 (2019-09-13 'CURLOPT_SSL_OPTIONS: add *_NATIVE_CA to use Windows CA store (with openssl)', git log -S traced)

vulnerability.summary: libcurl reuses an HTTPS connection without checking that both requests used the same CURLSSLOPT_NATIVE_CA disposition, so the second request may be validated in a weaker CA-store context than requested.
vulnerability.verification_level: source-level only; runtime repro requires Windows/Schannel or GnuTLS backend (reporter's Linux minimal build cannot trigger, declared as such in submission)
vulnerability.runtime_repro_hint: two HTTPS requests to one host with the second flipping CURLSSLOPT_NATIVE_CA; observe reuse via CURLINFO_NUM_CONNECTS

form.type: 组件通信与逻辑类 (子类型留空：四个选项均不匹配 CWE-488，非必填)
form.attachments: 附件包_CVE-2026-80231.zip (curl_gap_verification.json / 82209运行验证记录_姊妹案参考.md / 上游公告及修复对照.txt / 复核脚本_80231.sh)

fix_recommendation: 上游修复口径：match_ssl_primary_config() 的配置字段枚举补入 native_ca_store，使 HTTPS 连接复用时校验原生 CA 存储设置差异（字段枚举遗漏定位见 case.json oh_source.gap_evidence 与工单 OHSA26-092209031 源码级证据评论）。
trigger_conditions: 同一主机先后两次 HTTPS 请求间混用 CURLSSLOPT_NATIVE_CA 开关（默认 CA → NATIVE_CA 或反向）；该选项仅 Schannel/GnuTLS 等特定 TLS 后端支持，运行级复现需对应后端环境（Linux 最小构建不触发，本案如实申报为源级）。
attack_path: 应用在不同请求间对同一主机混用 NATIVE_CA 设置：OH 检出连接匹配逻辑未比较 native_ca_store（grep 零出现；上游 vtls_config.c:144 已修），第二个请求复用既有连接，证书校验语境与请求方指定 CA 来源不一致。
reproduction_commands: 源级三侧对照（无运行级 PoC，如实申报）：a) 上游 curl master vtls_config.c:144 连接比较含 native_ca_store；b) OH 检出 grep -rn native_ca_store 仅 setopt.c 两处赋值与 urldata.h 字段定义，连接匹配零出现；c) 官方受影响清单含 8.8.0（OH 快照基线）。运行级复现路径：Windows+Schannel 下同主机两请求切换 CURLSSLOPT_NATIVE_CA，CURLINFO_NUM_CONNECTS 观测复用差异。

master.reference: submission_82209（复核脚本_80231.sh + curl_gap_verification.json；OH 检出连接匹配逻辑零比较 native_ca_store，上游 vtls_config.c:144 已修）
